intro: Professionals and everyday users convert ounces (oz) to kilograms (kg) when working across imperial and si standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One ounce equals 0.02835 kilograms, while 1 kilogram equals 35.273962 ounces. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Precious Metal Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: How many kilograms (kg) are in 1 ounce (oz)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.02834952 kilograms (kg) in 1 ounce (oz), which rounds to 0.0283 kg for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 kilogram equals 35.273962 ounces.

faqs.question: How do I convert ounces to kilograms (oz to kg)?
faqs.answer: To convert ounces to kilograms, use the formula: kg = oz × 0.02834952. For example, converting 6 oz gives 0.1701 kg.

faqs.question: What is 6 ounces in kilograms?
faqs.answer: 6 ounces (oz) equals exactly 0.1701 kilograms (kg) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
